// before
pub machine Counter on i32 {
    limit: i32,
    scale: i64,
    start Idle;
    state Idle {
        0 -> stay,
        n -> goto Counting(n, 0),
    }
    state Counting(total: i32, seen: i32) {
        0 -> goto Done(total),
        n -> { if (n > self.limit) { goto Done(total); } goto Counting(total + n, seen + 1); },
    }
    final state Done(total: i32) {
        _ -> stay,
    }
}
// after
